questions.stem: What is the main role of the permanent vacuole in a plant cell?

options.text: To produce proteins for the cell
To control which genes are expressed
To carry out photosynthesis using chlorophyll
To maintain turgor pressure and store cell sap

questions.explanation: The permanent vacuole is filled with cell sap and maintains turgor pressure, which keeps the cell firm and helps support the whole plant. It also stores dissolved sugars, salts, and pigments.
